title: Phylogenetic Classification of Bacterial Populations Using Core SNPs and Accessory Genes
author: Jared Johnson

substeps.instruction: Run the command: unicycler -1 short_reads_1.fastq.gz -2 short_reads_2.fastq.gz -o output_dir

steps.title: Assess assembly quality
steps.instruction: Perform optional quality checks on assembled and reference genomes using BUSCO and Quast.

substeps.instruction: Run BUSCO: busco -i assembly.fasta -o output_dir -m genome -l reference_id
Run Quast: quast.py -i assembly_directory/*.fasta -o output_directory -r reference.fasta

steps.title: Filter genome assemblies
steps.instruction: Reject assemblies based on quality metrics.

substeps.instruction: Reject assemblies with >1% missing, fragmented, or duplicated (MFD) BUSCOs.
Reject assemblies with estimated genome sizes three standard deviations from the mean of high-quality reference genomes for that species.

steps.title: Annotate genome assemblies
steps.instruction: Annotate all genome assemblies, including reference genomes, using Prokka.

substeps.instruction: Run the command: prokka --kingdom Bacteria --outdir output_directory --genus bacterial_genus --locustag isolate_id assembly.fasta
Move the resulting .gff annotation files to a single directory.

steps.title: Assemble the pangenome
steps.instruction: Assemble the pangenome using Panaroo with core gene alignment using MAFFT.

substeps.instruction: Run the command: panaroo -i gff_directory/*.gff -o output_directory -a core --aligner mafft

steps.title: Check for problematic assemblies
steps.instruction: Identify problematic genome assemblies in the pangenome using pan_check.R.

substeps.instruction: Run the command: Rscript pan_check.R gene_presence_absence.Rtab
Review the resulting heatmap for isolates missing genes shared by others.

steps.title: Re-assemble pangenome if necessary
steps.instruction: If problematic assemblies were identified in the previous step, remove them and re-assemble the pangenome.

steps.title: Extract core SNPs
steps.instruction: Extract single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) from the core gene alignment using SNP-sites, using the '-c' flag to exclude gaps.

substeps.instruction: Create alignment file: snp-sites -c core_gene_alignment.aln > core_snps.aln
Create variant call format file: snp-sites -c -v core_gene_alignment.aln > core_snps.vcf

steps.title: Extract accessory genes
steps.instruction: Extract accessory genes using accessory_binary_genes.py (requires Pandas installation).

substeps.instruction: Run the command: python3 accessory_binary_genes.py -i gene_presence_absence.Rtab -o accessory_genes.binary

steps.title: Create phylogenetic trees
steps.instruction: Generate phylogenetic trees from accessory genes and core SNPs using RAXML, adjusting seed numbers and bootstraps as needed.

substeps.instruction: For Accessory genome (BINCAT model): raxml -s accessory_genes.bin -n output_file_name -m BINCAT -f a -T 2 -x 11 -N 100 -p 11
For SNPs (GTRCAT model): raxml -s core_snps.aln -n output_file_name -m GTRCAT -f a -T 2 -x 11 -N 100 -p 11
Optional rooting step: raxml -T 3 -f I -m GTRCAT -t input_file -n output_file_name

steps.title: Calculate pairwise differences
steps.instruction: Calculate pairwise gene and SNP differences using pair_diff.py.

substeps.instruction: Run the command: python3 pair_diff.py -g gene_presence_absence.Rtab -s core_snps.vcf -o gene_snp_differences.csv
